name: lecture-notes
description: Turn lecture slides and transcripts into complete living notes, using Notion as the default editable Master Note.

interface.longDescription: Create complete, readable Master Notes from lecture slides and transcripts, save them as editable Notion pages, then keep improving the same note through questions, inline comments, targeted rewrites, and coverage checks. Google Docs remains an optional fallback/export destination.
capabilities: Create notes from slides and lecture transcripts
Preserve formulas, proofs, examples, and instructor additions
Read Notion comments attached to selected text
Refine a Master Note without appending duplicate explanations
Optionally create or update Google Docs
defaultPrompt: Create an editable Notion Master Note from my uploaded slides and transcript.
Process the comments I just added to my Notion lecture note.
Check my current Master Note against the slides and transcript for missing knowledge points.
